findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: CT log query found risky_hostnames_count=1: hostname staging.copperline.example, pattern staging, first_seen 2025-03-02, last_seen 2026-09-15; unique_hostnames=12.

findings.deal_impact: Publicly logged staging hostname suggests a pre-production system may be internet-reachable, increasing attack surface and diligence focus on staging access controls and data segregation; no severity adjustment from baseline.

remediation.summary: Inventory staging.copperline.example, confirm need for public access, restrict with authentication/VPN or remove, and review staging data and secrets exposure.
